name: You.com Inference Router
desc: Open-weight models behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
desc_zh: 一套兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口的开源模型入口
solves: Switching providers meant rewriting the client and losing web grounding. One base URL and one key serve both endpoint styles, and the model can call You.com search mid-answer.
solves_zh: 换供应商往往要改客户端，还会丢掉联网能力。一个地址加一把密钥兼容两种接口，模型还能中途联网搜索。
best_for: You already run an OpenAI or Anthropic SDK and want a grounded alternative without a rewrite.
best_for_zh: 你已经在用 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 的 SDK，想换成能联网的模型又不想重写代码。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://you.com/docs/changelog (the vendor's own changelog directory)）。 The docs describe it as leading open-weight models through one API, grounded in real-time web search that runs server-side, priced per model with no platform fee. Declaring a web_search or web_extract tool makes the router run You.com searches and page fetches for the model and return every source it used. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「Inference Router」是通用词，带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://you.com/docs/changelog/2026/10/26
